name: Hunyuan3D-Part
description: Mesh part decomposition using Tencent Hunyuan3D-Part. Accepts a GLB mesh and returns a multi-part decomposed GLB.
author: iammojogo

params_schema.label: Inference Steps
params_schema.tooltip: Number of diffusion steps for X-Part generation. More steps = better part boundaries, slower.

params_schema.label: Mesh Resolution
params_schema.tooltip: Marching-cubes octree resolution. Higher = finer output mesh detail but much more VRAM.

params_schema.label: Decode Chunks
params_schema.tooltip: Marching-cubes chunk size. Lower = less peak VRAM per step. Use 2048-4096 for 12 GB GPUs.

params_schema.label: Max Parts
params_schema.tooltip: Maximum number of parts to decompose the mesh into. Higher values need more VRAM and time.

params_schema.label: BBox Decimate Target

options.label: Off — use full mesh (may hang on dense meshes)

params_schema.tooltip: Decimates the mesh to this face count before SAM bounding-box prediction. Full-resolution meshes with 500k+ faces will hang without decimation. Set to Off only if your mesh is already low-poly.

params_schema.label: Seed
params_schema.tooltip: Change if decomposition result is unsatisfying.
